name: cédula de identidad personal number (for a natural person, the Registro Único de Contribuyente, RUC)
issuer: the Tribunal Electoral (Dirección Nacional de Cedulación), from the entry in the Civil Registry
note: Panama's sheet (its government's own sheet on the OECD's automatic-exchange portal ('Information on Tax Identification Numbers'; the OECD's index page sits behind a bot check and wasn't opened, the sheet itself came straight back)), read 2026-10-30: a natural person's RUC is the number of their personal identity card (cédula); Decree 53 of 29 July 1958, art. 9, as the sheet quotes it, numbers a Panamanian by birth's card by the key number of the province of birth (1 to 13) followed by the volume and entry of their registration in the Civil Registry (example 8-926-1601); Panamanians born abroad carry PE, the naturalized N, and foreigners legally domiciled E with a province code and an application order number. Read as given at birth (the number is the birth's Civil Registry entry), to citizens and residents. The number's length varies (one to two, one to four and one to four digits); the format holds an eight-character Panamanian-born number like the example, written without its hyphens, and doesn't draw the PE, N, E or NT forms. The RUC must be activated by registering with the DGI (needed: tax); the DGI's two-digit check number (DV) is not part of the number and isn't held. No age, fee or time is stated.

sources.title: OECD AEOI portal, Panama: Information on Tax Identification Numbers (the jurisdiction's own sheet)
sources.said: For a natural person, the RUC number is the same as their personal identity card number. ... The first number identifies the province or region (1-13) of birth of the taxpayer. ... [1 to 2 digits] – [1 to 4 digits] – [1 to 4 digits] DV ... For Panamanian citizens by birth, the key number of the applicant's province of birth is used, followed by the volume and entry in which it appears registered in the Civil Registry. ... For example: 8-926-1601 ... For foreigners legally domiciled in the country, the letter (E) will be used ... Registration of the RUC is essential for the tax compliance of natural and legal persons
